verse.unicode: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਭੇਟੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਮਝਾਇਆ ॥

transliteration.english: firat firat bheTe jan saadhoo poorai gur samajhaiaa ||

en.bdb: Wandering and roaming around, I met the Holy Perfect Guru, who has taught me.

verse.unicode: ਆਨ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਧਿ ਕਾਂਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: aan sagal bidh kaa(n)m na aavai har har naam dhiaaiaa ||1||

en.bdb: All other devices did not work, so I meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਓਟ ਗੋਪਾਲ ॥

transliteration.english: taa te moh dhaaree oT gopaal ||

en.bdb: For this reason, I sought the Protection and Support of my Lord, the Cherisher of the Universe.

verse.unicode: ਸਰਨਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸਗਲ ਜੰਜਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥

transliteration.english: saran pario pooran paramesur binase sagal ja(n)jaal || rahaau ||

en.bdb: I sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Transcendent Lord, and all my entanglements were dissolved. ||Pause||

verse.unicode: ਸੁਰਗ ਮਿਰਤ ਪਇਆਲ ਭੂ ਮੰਡਲ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਪੇ ਮਾਇ ॥

transliteration.english: surag mirat piaal bhoo ma(n)ddal sagal biaape mai ||

en.bdb: Paradise, the earth, the nether regions of the underworld, and the globe of the world - all are engrossed in Maya.

verse.unicode: ਜੀਅ ਉਧਾਰਨ ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਨ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: jeea udhaaran sabh kul taaran har har naam dhiaai ||2||

en.bdb: To save your soul, and liberate all your ancestors, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||

verse.unicode: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਗਾਈਐ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥

transliteration.english: naanak naam nira(n)jan gaieeaai paieeaai sarab nidhaanaa ||

en.bdb: O Nanak, singing the Naam, the Name of the Immaculate Lord, all treasures are obtained.

verse.unicode: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਦੇਇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥੩॥੨੧॥

transliteration.english: kar kirapaa jis dhei suaamee birale kaahoo jaanaa ||3||3||21||

en.bdb: Only that rare person, whom the Lord and Master blesses with His Grace, comes to know this. ||3||3||21||
